s0101.literal: In the ninth month, guiwei day, the Great White star was seen in daylight.
s0101.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guiwei day the Great White was seen in daylight.

s0102.literal: In the tenth month of winter, jiyou day, an edict said: "Plow and chisel suffice for oneself—this is called pure custom; the rise of tribute and tax is of long standing.
s0102.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jiyou day an edict said: "Plow and chisel suffice—that is pure custom; tribute and tax are of long standing.

s0103.literal: It is because the pole of the year is busy and one cannot but act.
s0103.idiomatic: It is because the year's pole is busy and one cannot but act.

s0104.literal: Yet laws and orders grow daily; theft and robbery are many; custom esteems shallow fraud; government rarely has the good.
s0104.idiomatic: Yet laws multiply; theft is rife; custom esteems fraud; government rarely finds the good.

s0105.literal: We toil from sun to deep night, pitying the loss of a single thing; We weep over guilt and blame Ourselves, ashamed that three thousand have not been set right.
s0105.idiomatic: We toil from sun to deep night, pitying the loss of a single thing; We weep over guilt and blame Ourselves, ashamed that three thousand have not been set right.

s0106.literal: The wang-ding tax was just promulgated, making strong shade issue together; We hear rich and poor alike are levied and the solitary weak doubly harmed—is this the intent to revive the exhausted and fan the sunstruck?
s0106.idiomatic: The wang-ding tax was just promulgated, making strong and shade levy together; We hear rich and poor alike are taxed and the weak doubly harmed—is this how to revive the exhausted?

s0107.literal: This is the harshness of lower clerks' rake and gather.
s0107.idiomatic: This is the harshness of petty clerks' rake and gather.

s0108.literal: Thus it is said, 'If the people are not sufficient, with whom is the ruler sufficient?'
s0108.idiomatic: Thus it is said, 'If the people are not sufficient, with whom is the ruler sufficient?'

s0109.literal: From Taijian year fourteen, wang-ding rent and tax not yet entered, all are pardoned and remitted.
s0109.idiomatic: From Taijian year 14, wang-ding rent and tax not yet paid in, all are pardoned and remitted.

s0110.literal: The hundred officials in charge of affairs, in judging the multitude of tasks, must remove and take what is level and fair; they must not use convenience to harm the people, make reputation for themselves, or obstruct and disorder the way of government."
s0110.idiomatic: Officials in charge must judge affairs fairly, not use convenience to harm the people, make reputation for themselves, or obstruct government."

s0111.literal: In the eleventh month, gengyin day, a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0111.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengyin day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0112.literal: On renshen day the state of Panpan sent envoys presenting local products.
s0112.idiomatic: On renshen day Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

s0113.literal: On wuyin day the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
s0113.idiomatic: On wuyin day Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

s0114.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, wuwu day, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
s0114.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring of year 3, wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.

s0115.literal: On gengwu day Garrison-the-Left General Prince of Changsha Shujian received his former title and was made opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes; General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Jingzhou Fan Yi was made protector general; Acting Minister of the Left Household and Recorder of the Masters of Writing Lu Qiong was made Minister of Personnel; Grand Master for the Imperial Insignia with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Yuan Jing was given special advancement.
s0115.idiomatic: On gengwu day Shujian, Prince of Changsha, garrison-the-left general, received his former title and a mansion equal to the three dukes; Fan Yi, general who campaigns west and Jingzhou inspector, was made protector general; Lu Qiong, acting minister of the left household and recorder, was made minister of personnel; Yuan Jing, grand master for the imperial insignia with golden seal and purple ribbon, received special advancement.

s0116.literal: In the third month, xinyou day, the former Inspector of Fengzhou Zhang Dabao raised troops in rebellion.
s0116.idiomatic: In the third month on xinyou day Zhang Dabao, former inspector of Fengzhou, raised troops in rebellion.

s0117.literal: In the fourth month of summer, gengxu day, the righteous army leader of Fengzhou Chen Jingxiang beheaded Dabao and sent the head to the capital.
s0117.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on gengxu day Chen Jingxiang, righteous army leader of Fengzhou, beheaded Dabao and sent the head to the capital.

s0118.literal: On the night of wuzi day in the eighth month of autumn the Old Man star appeared.
s0118.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi in the eighth month of autumn the Old Man star appeared.

s0119.literal: On jiyou day the Minister of the Left Household Xie
s0119.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xie of the left household ministry

s0121.idiomatic: You was made minister of personnel.

s0123.literal: In the ninth month, jiaxu day, Special Grand Master and Grand Master for the Imperial Insignia with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Yuan Jing died.
s0123.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiaxu day Yuan Jing, special grand master with golden seal and purple ribbon, died.

s0124.literal: In the tenth month of winter, jichou day, the state of Dandan sent envoys presenting local products.
s0124.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jichou day Dandan sent envoys with tribute.

s0125.literal: In the eleventh month, jiwei day, an edict said: "Confucius was born with supreme wisdom, his substance reaching utmost sagehood; he followed and transmitted the statutes and models, joining Heaven and Earth in virtue; he harmonized the elegance of the Ya and Song, sharing brightness with sun and moon; he handed down instruction for later generations and opened the ears and eyes of the living.
s0125.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiwei day an edict said: "Confucius was born with supreme wisdom, his substance utmost sage; he followed and transmitted statutes and models, joining Heaven and Earth in virtue; he harmonized the Ya and Song, sharing brightness with sun and moon; he handed down instruction for later generations and opened the ears and eyes of the living.

s0126.literal: The Liang age declined to the subtle; the spirit shrine was forgotten in place; it grew into rank grass for more than thirty years; looking up in respect as if present, We ever think with grief and sighing.
s0126.idiomatic: The Liang age declined; the spirit shrine was forgotten; rank grass grew for more than thirty years; looking up as if present, We ever grieve and sigh.

s0127.literal: Now the elegant Way flourishes in glory; the pole of the year has its place; the broken zither's old shoes, fallen and scattered, are not pursued; opening the casket and books, there is no way to follow and restore.
s0127.idiomatic: Now the elegant Way flourishes; the year's pole has its place; the broken zither's old shoes, fallen and scattered, are not pursued; opening casket and books, there is no way to restore.

s0128.literal: Without, let the ritual canon be examined in detail; the old temple rebuilt; orchid rooms and cassia beams all made anew; fragrant offerings and pure libations sacrificed at the proper seasons.
s0128.idiomatic: Let the ritual canon be examined; the old temple rebuilt; orchid rooms and cassia beams made anew; fragrant offerings sacrificed in season.

s0129.literal: " On xinsi day the imperial carriage visited Changgan Temple; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0129.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor visited Changgan Temple; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

s0130.literal: In the twelfth month, bingxu day, the Great White star was seen in daylight.
s0130.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingxu day the Great White was seen in daylight.

s0131.literal: On xinmao day the crown prince left the Imperial Academy, lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety; on wuxu day the lecture ended.
s0131.idiomatic: On xinmao day the crown prince left the Imperial Academy and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety; on wuxu the lecture ended.

s0132.literal: On xinchou day sacrifice was offered to the former teacher; when the rites ended, stone and metal music was set; a gathering feast was held for kings, dukes, ministers, and gentlemen.
s0132.idiomatic: On xinchou day sacrifice was offered to the former teacher; when the rites ended, stone and metal music was set and kings, dukes, ministers, and gentlemen feasted.

s0133.literal: On guimao day the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
s0133.idiomatic: On guimao day Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

s0134.literal: That year Xiao Kui died; his son Zong succeeded.
s0134.idiomatic: That year Xiao Kui died; his son Zong succeeded.

s0135.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, jiayin day, an edict said: "Yao set up the remonstrance drum and Yu bowed to flourishing words; seeking them in different ranks, long recorded in former annals, Editorial footnote marker 12. raising the submerged and stagnant, again heard in past canon—this is the deep rule of governing the Way and the urgent task of emperors and kings.
s0135.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 4 on jiayin day an edict said: "Yao set up the remonstrance drum and Yu bowed to flourishing words; seeking them in different ranks is long in former annals [12]; raising the submerged is again in past canon—this is the deep rule of government and the urgent task of kings.

s0136.literal: We, dim and young, greatly inherit the great thread; not yet enlightened to empty Ourselves, from sun to night Our breast rises; the myriad tasks are many and tangled; the four hearings are not
s0136.idiomatic: We, dim and young, inherit the great thread; not yet enlightened to empty Ourselves, from sun to night Our breast rises; the myriad tasks tangle; the four hearings are not

s0138.literal: [reached]; Editorial footnote marker 13. We think to hear blunt remonstrance and gather plans.
s0138.idiomatic: reached [13]; We mean to hear blunt remonstrance and gather plans.

s0139.literal: Kings, dukes, and below—each recommend whom he knows; broadly inquire of storehouses, reaching even to carriage men; if one man has ability or one phrase is usable, We will personally listen and wait to be moistened.
s0139.idiomatic: Kings, dukes, and below—each recommend whom he knows; inquire of storehouses down to carriage men; if one man has ability or one phrase is usable, We will listen and wait to be moistened.

s0140.literal: Grand General of Central Authority, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Poyang Boshan, was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons the Guard; Grand General of the Central Guard, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was advanced in title to General of Agile Cavalry, Editorial footnote marker 14. Garrison-the-Left General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was advanced in title to Grand General of the Central Army; General Who Pacifies South, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons the Right; Aide-right General, Prince of Yidu Shuming, was advanced in title to Secure-the-Right General.
s0140.idiomatic: Boshan, Prince of Poyang, grand general of central authority and opener equal to the three dukes, was promoted to general who garrisons the guard; Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, grand general of the central guard and opener equal to the three dukes, to general of agile cavalry [14]; Shujian, Prince of Changsha, garrison-the-left general and opener equal to the three dukes, to grand general of the central army; Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, general who pacifies south, to general who garrisons the right; Shuming, Prince of Yidu, aide-right general, to secure-the-right general.

s0141.literal: In the second month, gengxu day, General Who Garrisons the Right, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was made special grand master.
s0141.idiomatic: In the second month on gengxu day Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, general who garrisons the right, was made special grand master.

s0142.literal: On gengshen day the imperial younger brother Shumo was established as Prince of Badong; Shuxian as Prince of Linjiang; Shutan as Prince of Xinhui; Shulong as Prince of Xinning.
s0142.idiomatic: On gengshen day the imperial brother Shumo was made Prince of Badong; Shuxian Prince of Linjiang; Shutan Prince of Xinhui; Shulong Prince of Xinning.

s0143.literal: In the fifth month of summer, dingsi day, the prince Zhuang was established as Prince of Kuaiji.
s0143.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer on dingsi day Prince Zhuang was made Prince of Kuaiji.

s0144.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, jiawu day, the imperial carriage visited Black Tortoise Lake, unmoored the tower ships and reviewed arms, Editorial footnote marker 15. feasted the host of ministers and composed poems.
s0144.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn on jiawu day the emperor visited Black Tortoise Lake, unmoored tower ships and reviewed arms [15], feasted ministers and composed poems.

s0145.literal: On wuxu day General Who Garrisons the Guard, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Poyang Boshan, was made Inspector of East Yangzhou; Sagacious Martial General, Prince of Yueyang Shushen, was made Administrator of Danyang.
s0145.idiomatic: On wuxu day Boshan, Prince of Poyang, general who garrisons the guard and opener equal to the three dukes, was made East Yangzhou inspector; Shushen, Prince of Yueyang, sagacious martial general, was made Danyang administrator.

s0146.literal: On dingwei day the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
s0146.idiomatic: On dingwei day Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

s0147.literal: In the tenth month of winter, guihai day, Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Jiang Zong was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Minister of Personnel Xie You was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.
s0147.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on guihai day Jiang Zong, vice minister, was made director of the Masters of Writing; Xie You, minister of personnel, was made vice minister.

s0148.literal: In the eleventh month, jimao day, an edict said: "Only punishment stops violence; only virtue completes things—the three talents are the resource; the hundred kings do not change.
s0148.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jimao day an edict said: "Only punishment stops violence; only virtue completes things—the three talents are the resource; the hundred kings do not change.

s0149.literal: Yet the age has no horn-locking; times rarely see scale-tearing; at Wei Bridge the startled horse is not heard in court contention; at Peach Grove the escaped ox is not seen in its intent.
s0149.idiomatic: Yet the age has no horn-locking; times rarely see scale-tearing; at Wei Bridge the startled horse is not heard in court contention; at Peach Grove the escaped ox is not seen in its intent.

s0150.literal: Though fierce and light in insult, reason follows the fetters; though stupid and mute, one should broadly show pity—government lacks the good, and brightness is ashamed before the wise; seeking rest from punishment—how can it be obtained?
s0150.idiomatic: Though fierce and insulting, reason follows fetters; though stupid and mute, pity should be shown—government lacks the good and brightness is ashamed before the wise; seeking rest from punishment—how can it be obtained?

s0151.literal: Therefore We turn sleeplessness in Our breast and bear the throne mat in sorrow.
s0151.idiomatic: Therefore We turn sleepless in Our breast and bear the throne mat in sorrow.

s0152.literal: Again the joined jade has a gap and the continuous pearls' warp is awry; the yellow bell offers the lü and harmonious qi begins to sprout; dark glory announces the center and treading long is in hand—according to the season pardon faults; this is what is obtained.
s0152.idiomatic: Again the joined jade has a gap and the pearls' warp is awry; the yellow bell offers the lü and harmony begins to sprout; dark glory announces the center and long treading is in hand—according to the season pardon faults; this is what is obtained.

s0153.literal: A great amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
s0153.idiomatic: A great amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm."

s0154.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhenming, gengzi day, General Who Secures the Van, Prince of Hengyang Boxin, was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons the Van; General Who Pacifies East and Administrator of Wuxing, Prince of Luling Boren, was made special grand master, Editorial footnote marker 16. Sagacious Martial General and Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Yueyang Shushen, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; Benevolent Martial General, Prince of Yiyang Shuda, was made Administrator of Danyang.
s0154.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of Zhenming year 1 on gengzi day Boxin, Prince of Hengyang, general who secures the van, was promoted to general who garrisons the van; Boren, Prince of Luling, general who pacifies east and Wuxing administrator, was made special grand master [16]; Shushen, Prince of Yueyang, sagacious martial general and Danyang administrator, was made Xiangzhou inspector; Shuda, Prince of Yiyang, benevolent martial general, was made Danyang administrator.

s0155.literal: On wuyin day an edict said: "Bolhuang and Great Court beat pure harmony in days of old; the Ji king and Ying queen spread thin custom in the last age; when the penal writing was already cast, good transformation did not blend; when ritual and righteousness were already awry, treachery and villainy arose.
s0155.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict said: "Bolhuang and Great Court beat pure harmony in days of old; the Ji king and Ying queen spread thin custom in the last age; when penal writing was cast, good transformation did not blend; when ritual and righteousness were awry, treachery arose.

s0156.literal: How is it that pure simplicity does not return and floating show competes in fanning?
s0156.idiomatic: How is it that pure simplicity does not return and floating show competes in fanning?

s0157.literal: We occupy the center and receive things; the moat is in Our gaze; repeatedly We have restored Heaven's net and again cut off the three borders—yet the black-haired common people ultimately suffer the five punishments.
s0157.idiomatic: We occupy the center and receive things; the moat is in Our gaze; repeatedly We have restored Heaven's net and cut the three borders—yet the people ultimately suffer the five punishments.

s0158.literal: It is because 'How prosperous' is slight in merit and laws and orders grow daily.
s0158.idiomatic: It is because Our merit is slight and laws and orders grow daily.

s0159.literal: Therefore facing the throne We are not pleased; We pity this cornered mood.
s0159.idiomatic: Therefore facing the throne We are not pleased; We pity this cornered mood.

s0160.literal: Now the three origins are in order and the myriad states attend the court; spirit fungus was presented at Shiyang and sweet dew congealed in this year—from spring issue orders, looking up to Heaven spread virtue, thinking with the nine realms to renew the seven policies.
s0160.idiomatic: Now the three origins are in order and the myriad states attend court; spirit fungus was presented at Shiyang and sweet dew congealed this year—from spring issue orders, looking up to Heaven spread virtue, thinking with the nine realms to renew the seven policies.

s0161.literal: A great amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm; Zhide year five is changed to Zhenming year one.
s0161.idiomatic: A great amnesty is proclaimed; Zhide year 5 is renamed Zhenming year 1.

s0162.literal: On yiwei day there was an earthquake.
s0162.idiomatic: On yiwei day there was an earthquake.

s0163.literal: On guimao day General Who Garrisons the Van, Prince of Hengyang Boxin, was made General Who Garrisons South and Inspector of West Hengzhou.
s0163.idiomatic: On guimao day Boxin, Prince of Hengyang, general who garrisons the van, was made general who garrisons south and West Hengzhou inspector.

s0164.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, guimao day, the Old Man star appeared.
s0164.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn on guimao day the Old Man star appeared.

s0165.literal: On dingwei day General of Chariots and Cavalry Xiao Mohe was made General of Agile Cavalry.
s0165.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiao Mohe, general of chariots and cavalry, was made general of agile cavalry.

s0167.literal: In the ninth month, yihai day, General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
s0167.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yihai day Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, general of agile cavalry and opener equal to the three dukes, was made grand general of agile cavalry.

s0168.literal: On gengyin day Xiao Zong's appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Tutor, Prince of Ping'an Yan, Editorial footnote marker 18. Central Army General and Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Yixing Xuan, Editorial footnote marker 19. sent his Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Jungong to Jingzhou Inspector Chen Ji to request surrender.
s0168.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yan, Prince of Ping'an, whom Xiao Zong had appointed director and grand tutor [18], and Xuan, Prince of Yixing, central army general and Jingzhou inspector [19], sent their director of the Masters of Writing Shen Jungong to Chen Ji, inspector of Jingzhou, to request surrender.

s0169.literal: Editorial footnote marker 20. On xinmao day Yan and the rest led civil and military, men and women, more than a hundred thousand mouths to cross the river.
s0169.idiomatic: [20] On xinmao day Yan and the rest led civil and military, men and women, more than a hundred thousand to cross the river.

s0170.literal: On jiawu day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0170.idiomatic: On jiawu day a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0171.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, yihai day, Yangzhou's Wu commandery was split to establish Wu prefecture; Qiantang county was split as a commandery and attached to it.
s0171.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter on yihai day Yangzhou's Wu commandery was split to establish Wu prefecture; Qiantang county was made a commandery and attached.

s0172.literal: On gengzi day Yan was made Pacify East General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou; Xuan was made Pacify East General and Inspector of Wu prefecture.
s0172.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yan was made pacify east general, opener equal to the three dukes, and East Yangzhou inspector; Xuan was made pacify east general and Wu prefecture inspector.

s0173.literal: On dinghai day Grand General of Agile Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Prince of Yuzhang Shuying, was concurrently made Minister of Education.
s0173.idiomatic: On dinghai day Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang, grand general of agile cavalry and opener equal to the three dukes, was concurrently made minister of education.

s0174.literal: In the twelfth month, gengchen day, the former General Who Garrisons the Guard, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, Prince of Poyang Boshan, was made Grand General Who Garrisons the Guard, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Editorial footnote marker 21. the former Grand General of the Central Guard, Prince of Jin'an Bogong, was made Grand General of the Central Guard and Right Grand Master of the Glory.
s0174.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengchen day Boshan, Prince of Poyang, former general who garrisons the guard, opener equal to the three dukes, and East Yangzhou inspector, was made grand general who garrisons the guard with a mansion equal to the three dukes [21]; Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, former grand general of the central guard, was made grand general of the central guard and right grand master of the glory.

s0175.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, xinsi day, the prince Quan was established as Prince of Dongyang; Tian as Prince of Qiantang.
s0175.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of year 2 on xinsi day Prince Quan was made Prince of Dongyang; Tian Prince of Qiantang.

s0176.literal: That month Scattered Cavalry Regular Attendant Zhou Luohou led troops to garrison at Xiakou.
s0176.idiomatic: That month Zhou Luohou, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, led troops to garrison Xiakou.

s0177.literal: In the fourth month of summer, wushen day, a swarm of rats without number from [Cai] Isle's shore entered Shitou, crossed the ford on the Huai, Editorial footnote marker 22. reaching both banks of Qingtang; after several days they died and flowed out with the current into the river.
s0177.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer on wushen day countless rats from Cai Isle's shore entered Shitou, crossed the Huai ford [22], reaching both banks of Qingtang; after several days they died and flowed out into the river.

s0178.literal: On wuwu day Minister of the Left Household Cai Zheng was made Minister of Personnel.
s0178.idiomatic: On wuwu day Cai Zheng of the left household ministry was made minister of personnel.

s0179.literal: That month the Nanpu water of Yingzhou was black as ink.
s0179.idiomatic: That month the Nanpu water of Yingzhou was black as ink.

s0180.literal: In the fifth month, renyang day, General Who Secures the Van, Prince of Luling Boren, was made special grand master.
s0180.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renyang day Boren, Prince of Luling, general who secures the van, was made special grand master.

s0181.literal: On jiawu day in the eastern foundry iron was cast; there was a thing red as several dou, Editorial footnote marker 23. falling from heaven into the smelting place, with a sound rumbling like thunder; iron flew outside the wall and burned people's houses.
s0181.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the eastern foundry iron was cast; a thing red as several dou [23] fell from heaven into the smelter, rumbling like thunder; iron flew outside the wall and burned houses.

s0182.literal: In the sixth month, wuxu day, the state of Funan sent envoys presenting local products.
s0182.idiomatic: In the sixth month on wuxu day Funan sent envoys with tribute.

s0183.literal: On gengzi day the crown prince Yin was deposed as Prince of Wuxing; the Military Adviser General and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Shian Shen, was established as crown prince.
s0183.idiomatic: On gengzi day Crown Prince Yin was deposed as Prince of Wuxing; Shen, Prince of Shian, military adviser general and Yangzhou inspector, was made crown prince.

s0184.literal: On xinchou day Pacify South General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Nanping Yan, was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons South;
s0184.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yan, Prince of Nanping, pacify south general and Jiangzhou inspector, was promoted to general who garrisons south;

s0185.literal: Loyal Martial General and Inspector of South Xuzhou, Prince of Yongjia Yan, was advanced in title to General Who Secures the North;
s0185.idiomatic: Yan, Prince of Yongjia, loyal martial general and South Xuzhou inspector, was promoted to general who secures the north;

s0186.literal: Prince of Kuaiji Zhuang was made Aide-before-the-Throne General and Inspector of Yangzhou;
s0186.idiomatic: Zhuang, Prince of Kuaiji, was made aide-before-the-throne general and Yangzhou inspector;

s0187.literal: Manifest Grace General and Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Zong was advanced in title to Central Authority General;
s0187.idiomatic: Jiang Zong, manifest grace general and director of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to central authority general;

s0188.literal: Cloud Banner General and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Xian was made Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing;
s0188.idiomatic: Yuan Xian, cloud banner general and junior tutor of the heir apparent, was made vice minister;

s0189.literal: Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Xie You was made special grand master;
s0189.idiomatic: Xie You, vice minister, was made special grand master;

s0190.literal: General of Far Pacification and newly appointed Minister of Personnel Cai Zheng was advanced in title to Secure-the-Right General.
s0190.idiomatic: Cai Zheng, general of far pacification and newly minister of personnel, was promoted to secure-the-right general.

s0191.literal: On jiachen day Secure-the-Right General Lu Guangda was made Central Army Commander.
s0191.idiomatic: On jiachen day Lu Guangda, secure-the-right general, was made central army commander.

s0192.literal: Editorial footnote marker 24. On dingsi day a great wind came from the northwest and drove the surging waters into Shitou city; the Huai's islets overflowed violently and boats were drowned.
s0192.idiomatic: See editorial note 24. On dingsi day a great wind came from the northwest and drove surging water into Shitou; the Huai's islets overflowed and boats were drowned.

s0193.literal: In the tenth month of winter, jihai day, the prince Fan was established as Prince of Wu commandery.
s0193.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter on jihai day Prince Fan was made Prince of Wu commandery.

s0194.literal: On xinchou day Minister of Revenue and Recorder of the Masters of Writing Yao Cha was made Minister of Personnel.
s0194.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yao Cha, minister of revenue and recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made minister of personnel.

s0195.literal: On jiyou day the imperial carriage visited Mofu Mountain and held a great hunt.
s0195.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor visited Mofu Mountain and held a great hunt.

s0196.literal: On dingmao day an edict said: "To deliberate on punishments and slow executions is what emperors and kings hand down as model; to overcome cruelty and remove killing is what humane men apply their hearts.
s0196.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict said: "To deliberate on punishments and slow executions is what emperors and kings hand down as model; to overcome cruelty and remove killing is what humane men apply their hearts.

s0197.literal: Since the painted cap ceased, the carving clerk arose; laws and orders grow daily and hands and feet have nowhere to place.
s0197.idiomatic: Since the painted cap ceased, the carving clerk arose; laws grow daily and hands and feet have nowhere to place.

s0198.literal: We face the realm in a time that is thin and shallow; the canon of light and heavy is not yet at peace in government; in small and great feeling We speak with much shame.
s0198.idiomatic: We face the realm in a thin age; the canon of light and heavy is not yet at peace; in small and great feeling We speak with much shame.

s0199.literal: Looking on these prisons, Our breast is moved to pity; on a set day in the Great Governance Hall trials may be held.
s0199.idiomatic: Looking on these prisons, Our breast is moved to pity; on a set day trials may be held in the Great Governance Hall.

s0200.literal: " On renshen day General Who Garrisons South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Nanping Yan, was made General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Yingzhou; General Who Secures the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou, Prince of Yongjia Yan, was made General Who Pacifies South and Inspector of Jiangzhou; Military Adviser General, Prince of Nanhai Qian, was made General Who Secures the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou.
s0200.idiomatic: On renshen day Yan, Prince of Nanping, general who garrisons south and Jiangzhou inspector, was made general who campaigns west and Yingzhou inspector; Yan, Prince of Yongjia, general who secures the north and South Xuzhou inspector, was made general who pacifies south and Jiangzhou inspector; Qian, Prince of Nanhai, military adviser general, was made general who secures the north and South Xuzhou inspector.
